For derived controls, evidence_grade grades the underlying finding, not the control.
Implementation of recommended measures was not verified unless measure_status is Adopted by operator (reported).

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Fuel load: many combustible materials near ignition sources in an oxygen cabin
measures.measure_description: Severely restrict and control the amount and location of combustible materials in the Command Module.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Pure-oxygen cabin atmosphere at 16.7 psia
measures.measure_description: Continue studies of a diluent gas in the cabin atmosphere, including gas detection, control and the risks of a two-gas atmosphere.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Coolant leakage at solder joints (coolant is corrosive and combustible)
measures.measure_description: Modify the design of soldered plumbing joints to increase integrity; eliminate the deleterious effects of coolant leakage and spillage.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Wiring deficiencies in design, manufacture, installation, rework and quality control
measures.measure_description: Use 3-dimensional jigs in the manufacture of wire bundles and enforce rigid inspection at all stages of wiring design, manufacture and installation.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Possible ignition source: electrical connections made or broken with power on in the crew compartment
measures.measure_description: Eliminate the necessity for electrical connections or disconnections with power on within the crew compartment.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Crew could not open the inner hatch or escape before rupture
measures.measure_description: Reduce the time required for crew egress and simplify the operations necessary for egress.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Egress paths with steps, sliding doors and sharp turns
measures.measure_description: Modify service structures and umbilical towers to facilitate emergency operations.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: No procedures established for this type of emergency; test not treated as hazardous
measures.measure_description: Management continually monitors the safety of all test operations and assures the adequacy of emergency procedures.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Emergency response unprepared
measures.measure_description: Give personnel training and practice for emergency procedures on a regular basis.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Emergency equipment not designed for the smoke from a fire of this nature
measures.measure_description: Review the adequacy of all emergency equipment (breathing apparatus, protective clothing, deluge systems, access arm, etc.).

measures.failure_mode_addressed: No means to control or extinguish a spacecraft cabin fire; crew exposed to smoke and toxic fumes
measures.measure_description: Investigate the most effective means of controlling and extinguishing a spacecraft fire; provide auxiliary breathing oxygen and crew protection from smoke and toxic fumes.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: No fire, rescue or medical teams in attendance; test not identified as hazardous
measures.measure_description: Classify a test with the crew in a pressurised 100% oxygen cabin as hazardous and have emergency fire, rescue and medical teams in attendance.
measures.notes: Derived from the Board finding that these teams were not in attendance and the test was not identified as hazardous; not a numbered recommendation.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Pre-test constraints list not completed; many engineering orders open at delivery
measures.measure_description: Complete and sign the pre-test constraints list and close outstanding engineering orders before the test.
measures.notes: Finding 11 reports 113 significant engineering orders not accomplished at delivery and 623 released afterwards.

measures.accident_name: Apollo 13 service module oxygen tank explosion
measures.failure_mode_addressed: Oxygen tank 2: heater/thermostat/Teflon-wiring ignition in liquid oxygen
measures.measure_description: Redesign and recertify the Service Module oxygen storage system.
measures.notes: Summary-level content as recorded in the Accidents sheet; the Board recommendation list itself was not read in this pass.

measures.accident_name: Apollo 13 service module oxygen tank explosion
measures.failure_mode_addressed: Material ignition in oxygen
measures.measure_description: Review all cryogenic oxygen systems for materials compatibility.
measures.notes: Summary-level content as recorded in the Accidents sheet; the Board recommendation list itself was not read in this pass.

measures.accident_name: Apollo 13 service module oxygen tank explosion
measures.failure_mode_addressed: Tank damaged by handling history (dropped about two inches in 1968) and not traceable
measures.measure_description: Require complete component histories.
measures.notes: Summary-level content as recorded in the Accidents sheet; the Board recommendation list itself was not read in this pass.

measures.accident_name: Apollo 13 service module oxygen tank explosion
measures.failure_mode_addressed: Single oxygen tank pair; loss of tank 2 cascaded to tank 1
measures.measure_description: Install a third oxygen tank in a different bay (Apollo 14 configuration).
measures.notes: Summary-level content as recorded in the Accidents sheet; the Board recommendation list itself was not read in this pass.

measures.accident_name: Apollo 13 service module oxygen tank explosion
measures.failure_mode_addressed: Thermostat switches failed to open under full current
measures.measure_description: Upgrade the heater thermostats (Apollo 14 configuration).
measures.notes: Summary-level content as recorded in the Accidents sheet; the Board recommendation list itself was not read in this pass.

measures.accident_name: Apollo 13 service module oxygen tank explosion
measures.failure_mode_addressed: Fan wiring in the tank as spark and stirring-ignition risk
measures.measure_description: Remove the tank fans (Apollo 14 configuration).
measures.notes: Summary-level content as recorded in the Accidents sheet; the Board recommendation list itself was not read in this pass.

measures.accident_name: Apollo 13 service module oxygen tank explosion
measures.failure_mode_addressed: Teflon-insulated wiring damaged in the tank
measures.measure_description: Sheath wiring in stainless steel (Apollo 14 configuration).
measures.notes: Summary-level content as recorded in the Accidents sheet; the Board recommendation list itself was not read in this pass.

measures.accident_name: Apollo 13 service module oxygen tank explosion
measures.failure_mode_addressed: Thermostat switches rated for 28 Vdc, ground power was 65 Vdc; never tested at full current
measures.measure_description: Qualify components for the actual voltage and current they will see in every operating mode, including ground support equipment power.
measures.notes: Derived from the Board analysis that the switches did not open reliably at 65 Vdc and qualification never checked opening under full current.

measures.accident_name: Apollo 13 service module oxygen tank explosion
measures.failure_mode_addressed: Wire insulation damage inside the tank not easily visible after assembly
measures.measure_description: Inspect insulation of wiring that is moved during assembly where damage cannot easily be seen.
measures.notes: Derived from the Board analysis that wire was moved extensively during assembly and detanking likely damaged it.

measures.accident_name: Apollo 13 service module oxygen tank explosion
measures.failure_mode_addressed: Extended heater and fan operation during detanking not understood; risk not raised with management
measures.measure_description: Make sure personnel understand the risk of extended heater and fan operation in off-nominal ground operations such as repeated detanking, and escalate it to management.
measures.notes: Derived from the Board analysis; heater tube temperature may have reached about 1,000 F.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: SRB aft field joint O-ring seal failure (hot-gas leak)
measures.measure_description: Change the faulty Solid Rocket Motor joint and seal: eliminate the joint or redesign it, without dropping options for schedule or cost reasons.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Joint performance in cold weather not proven by test
measures.measure_description: Prove the joint by test; ensure reliability across operating conditions including temperature; certify with tests closely replicating the launch configuration; consider static firing the flight configuration vertically.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Flawed design accepted despite known issues
measures.measure_description: NASA Administrator asks the National Research Council to form an independent Solid Rocket Motor design oversight committee to review certification requirements and oversee design, testing and certification.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Unclear Shuttle program authority
measures.measure_description: Review the program structure and redefine the STS Program Manager responsibility; bring program funding and Shuttle work at the centres under that authority.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Operational and flight-crew experience missing from management
measures.measure_description: Bring qualified astronauts into NASA management and raise the position of the Flight Crew Operations director.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: No safety advisory function reporting to the program manager
measures.measure_description: Create a Shuttle Safety Panel reporting to the STS Program Manager covering operations, launch criteria, flight rules, readiness and risk management.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Criticality 1 and 2 items and hazard analyses not adequately reviewed
measures.measure_description: Review Criticality 1, 1R, 2 and 2R items and hazard analyses, identify what must be fixed before flight, and have a National Research Council audit panel verify and report to the Administrator.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Safety function lacked independence and authority
measures.measure_description: Establish an Office of Safety, Reliability and Quality Assurance led by an associate administrator reporting directly to the Administrator, with agency-wide authority and adequate staff.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Management isolation at Marshall; concerns not escalated
measures.measure_description: Address Marshall management isolation through personnel, organisational or indoctrination changes.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Launch constraints imposed and waived without clear policy
measures.measure_description: Develop a policy governing when Shuttle launch constraints are imposed and removed.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Flight readiness decisions not recorded
measures.measure_description: Record Flight Readiness Reviews and Mission Management Team meetings.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Flight crew not part of the readiness decision
measures.measure_description: Require the flight crew commander (or designee) to attend the Flight Readiness Review, take part in accepting the vehicle and certify crew readiness.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: No crew escape during ascent failure
measures.measure_description: Make every effort to provide a crew escape system for controlled gliding flight.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Limited emergency-landing options after early engine failures
measures.measure_description: Expand the range of conditions allowing a successful emergency runway landing if two or three main engines fail early in ascent.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Schedule and manifest pressure
measures.measure_description: Set a flight rate matched to NASA resources, reduce reliance on a single launch capability, set a firm payload assignment policy and tightly control cargo manifest changes.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Criticality 1 items not maintained rigorously
measures.measure_description: Make installation, testing and maintenance of Criticality 1 items especially rigorous, track performance trends and specify their maintenance in the Critical Items List, particularly for the main engines.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Orbiter maintenance and spares practices (including cannibalisation)
measures.measure_description: Develop a comprehensive Orbiter inspection plan, perform scheduled structural inspections without waivers, restore maintenance and spare parts programs and end cannibalisation of parts between Orbiters.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Landing safety margins (not tied to the accident mechanism)
measures.measure_description: Improve the tire, brake and nosewheel steering systems and do not plan landings at Kennedy until they meet criteria verified at Edwards; forecast landing-area weather more than an hour ahead.
measures.notes: Commission recommendation not linked to the SRB joint failure mode.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: External Tank foam shedding
measures.measure_description: Eliminate External Tank thermal protection debris shedding at the source, focusing on the bipod strut attachment area. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: RCC leading edge integrity unknown
measures.measure_description: Create and carry out a comprehensive inspection plan for RCC structural integrity using advanced non-destructive methods. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Orbiter intolerant of minor debris damage
measures.measure_description: Improve the Orbiter tolerance of minor debris damage (tougher RCC and acreage tiles) and measure actual impact resistance. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Re-entry with leading-edge damage
measures.measure_description: Improve the Orbiter ability to re-enter safely with minor leading-edge structural damage. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: RCC material properties poorly known
measures.measure_description: Build a database of flown RCC material properties through destructive testing. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Zinc primer leaching onto RCC
measures.measure_description: Maintain launch pad structures to reduce zinc primer leaching onto RCC components. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Debris strike not observed at launch
measures.measure_description: Provide at least three useful views of the Shuttle from liftoff to SRB separation, tracked in launch commit criteria; consider ships or aircraft. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: External Tank not imaged after separation
measures.measure_description: Image and downlink high-resolution views of the External Tank after separation. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Wing damage not imaged on orbit
measures.measure_description: Image and downlink high-resolution views of the wing leading edges and forward wing thermal protection. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Vehicle sensor suite out of date
measures.measure_description: Keep the Modular Auxiliary Data System sensor suite on each Orbiter current. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Limited engineering and health data
measures.measure_description: Redesign the MADS to capture engineering and vehicle health data and allow in-flight reconfiguration. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Maintenance decisions under schedule and cost pressure
measures.measure_description: Maintain enough spare RCC panels and support parts so maintenance decisions are free of schedule and cost pressure. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: No debris-impact damage thresholds
measures.measure_description: Develop and maintain physics-based models of debris impact damage with damage thresholds that trigger corrective action. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Bolt catcher hardware not qualified
measures.measure_description: Test and qualify flight hardware bolt catchers. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Aging Orbiter wiring
measures.measure_description: Develop a state-of-the-art means to inspect all Orbiter wiring, including inaccessible wiring, for a possible 40-year life. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Closeout and foam application errors
measures.measure_description: Require at least two employees at all final closeouts and intertank hand-spraying. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Micrometeoroid and orbital debris risk criteria only guidelines
measures.measure_description: Operate the Shuttle to the same micrometeoroid/orbital debris safety level as the ISS and make those criteria requirements rather than guidelines. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Foreign object debris definition inconsistent
measures.measure_description: Return to the standard industry definition of Foreign Object Debris and drop alternate definitions. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Schedule pressure
measures.measure_description: Keep the flight schedule consistent with available resources and regularly reassess schedule deadlines and their added risk. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Mission Management Team trained for launch and ascent only
measures.measure_description: Expand Mission Management Team training to cover contingencies beyond launch and ascent. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: On-orbit imaging not a standard requirement
measures.measure_description: Amend the NIMA agreement so on-orbit imaging of each flight is a standard requirement. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: No on-orbit inspection or repair of thermal protection
measures.measure_description: Develop on-orbit thermal protection inspection and repair capability (ISS and non-ISS missions), inspect early in every mission and aim for full autonomy. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Technical authority not independent of schedule and cost
measures.measure_description: Create an independent Technical Engineering Authority that sets technical standards, alone grants waivers, runs risk and hazard analysis and verifies launch readiness, funded separately from schedule and cost. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Safety organisation lacked independence
measures.measure_description: Give NASA HQ Safety and Mission Assurance direct authority over the entire Shuttle safety organisation, with independent resources. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Integration across Orbiter and other elements weak
measures.measure_description: Reorganise the Shuttle Integration Office so it can integrate all program elements, including the Orbiter. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Implementation of independent authority and safety changes
measures.measure_description: Produce a detailed plan for the independent authority, safety program and reorganised integration office, with annual reports to Congress. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Aging vehicle fleet
measures.measure_description: Recertify the vehicle at material, component, subsystem and system levels before operating beyond 2010. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Drawings differ from as-built hardware
measures.measure_description: Create interim closeout photographs for critical subsystems that differ from drawings and digitise them for on-orbit use. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Drawing system out of date
measures.measure_description: Fund a long-term upgrade of the drawing system: check accuracy, convert to CAD and incorporate engineering changes. (paraphrase of the CAIB text)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: AJ26 LO2 turbopump failure risk (design robustness, FOD, workmanship)
measures.measure_description: NASA should not rely on the AJ26 for further missions without undertaking a more thorough inspection.
measures.notes: Sentence appears cut off in the text read.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Engine not qualified for Antares operations
measures.measure_description: Orbital ATK ensures a thorough qualification program and acceptance test program specific to planned Antares operations.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Limited engine health data in flight
measures.measure_description: Provide additional main engine system sensors and sensor filtering for future Antares missions.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Acceptance test sensors poorly suited or placed
measures.measure_description: Use sensors more suitable to the test environment in future engine acceptance tests and place them better to characterise engine performance.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Foreign object debris in the LO2 turbopump
measures.measure_description: Implement greater insight and verification activities to ensure cleanliness.
measures.notes: Sentence appears cut off in the text read.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Moisture intrusion into the engine
measures.measure_description: Use a more robust and verifiable moisture barrier approach.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Limited customer insight into engine design and certification
measures.measure_description: Orbital ATK and NASA should have greater insight into and understanding of engine design, certification and operation.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Launch vehicle oversight within the ISS Program
measures.measure_description: Reassign launch vehicle management responsibility to a senior engineer at Marshall Space Flight Center with launch vehicle experience.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Launch vehicle issues not coordinated
measures.measure_description: Establish a standing working group to discuss and coordinate launch vehicle issues.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Anomaly and design information not shared
measures.measure_description: More fully disseminate launch vehicle design, anomaly and other information, within the constraints of the CRS contract.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Acceptable risk not defined
measures.measure_description: Formally define and communicate a baseline level of acceptable risk.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Immature commercial systems under fixed-price milestones
measures.measure_description: Allow time for system development and demonstration to be fully complete before fixed-price milestone contracts, perform greater due diligence on major components and require an integrated partnership between service providers and engine providers.
measures.notes: Paraphrase of the recommendation text.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Insufficient technical expertise on engine history
measures.measure_description: Service providers and NASA should have sufficient technical expertise and insight into engine design, development, test and failure history.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Strut failure released a helium COPV and ruptured the LOX tank
measures.measure_description: Replace the struts in all future tanks and use a strut with a higher safety margin.
measures.notes: Statement made at the time of the preliminary investigation.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Strut quality not verified
measures.measure_description: Test every strut before use.
measures.notes: Statement made at the time of the preliminary investigation.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Industrial-grade 17-4 PH stainless strut used in a critical load path
measures.measure_description: No longer use that type of strut for flight applications.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Wider hardware risk
measures.measure_description: Conduct a full review of Falcon 9 hardware to improve reliability.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Commercially sourced parts certified without adequate care
measures.measure_description: Apply greater care when certifying commercially sourced parts for flight.
measures.notes: Reported by a secondary article on the NASA IRT report; IRT report itself not read.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: No 4:1 safety factor; no adequate modelling or load testing of the part
measures.measure_description: Apply the supplier recommended 4:1 factor of safety and perform proper modelling and load testing under predicted flight conditions before flying an industrial-grade part.
measures.notes: Derived from the IRT contributing factors as reported.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Super-chilled LOX or solid oxygen trapped in COPV liner buckles
measures.measure_description: Change the COPV configuration to allow warmer helium to be loaded.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Helium loading conditions
measures.measure_description: Return helium loading operations to a prior flight-proven configuration.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: COPV buckles accumulate oxygen
measures.measure_description: Redesign the helium COPVs to prevent buckles altogether, which allows faster loading operations.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Alignment function kept running after liftoff
measures.measure_description: Switch off the alignment function of the inertial reference system immediately after liftoff; no software function should run in flight unless needed. (paraphrase)
measures.notes: Full report text read via a reproduction on a university course page.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Inertial reference systems not in closed-loop system tests
measures.measure_description: Build a test facility with as much real equipment as feasible, feed it realistic inputs and perform complete closed-loop system testing before every mission with high test coverage. (paraphrase)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Sensor stopped sending data on an exception
measures.measure_description: Do not allow any sensor, such as the inertial reference system, to stop sending best-effort data. (paraphrase)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Software qualification review missing
measures.measure_description: Organise a specific software qualification review for each item of equipment incorporating software, with the Industrial Architect taking part; state restrictions on use explicitly; make all critical software a Configuration Controlled Item. (paraphrase)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Flight software not fully reviewed
measures.measure_description: Review all flight software, including embedded software. (paraphrase)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Exception in one task shut down the processor
measures.measure_description: Wherever technically feasible, consider confining exceptions to tasks and devise backup capabilities. (paraphrase)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Little failure data recovered
measures.measure_description: Provide more data to telemetry upon failure of any component, so that recovering equipment is less essential. (paraphrase)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Software-origin single-point failures not treated as critical
measures.measure_description: Reconsider the definition of critical components, accounting for software-origin failures, especially single points of failure. (paraphrase)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Reviews lacked external participants
measures.measure_description: Include participants external to the project when reviewing specifications, code and justification documents, and examine the substance of arguments. (paraphrase)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Ariane 5 trajectory data missing from requirements
measures.measure_description: Include trajectory data in specifications and test requirements. (paraphrase)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Test coverage of existing equipment not reviewed
measures.measure_description: Review the test coverage of existing equipment and extend it where needed. (paraphrase)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Justification documents less rigorous than code
measures.measure_description: Give justification documents the same attention as code and improve how code and its justifications are kept consistent. (paraphrase)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: No common software qualification rules
measures.measure_description: Set up a team to define software qualification procedures and rules, ensuring consistently high quality in specification, verification and testing, with external RAMS experts considered. (paraphrase)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Unclear authority between partners
measures.measure_description: Make cooperation among partners more transparent, with close engineering cooperation, clear authority and responsibility and simple, clear interfaces. (paraphrase)

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Deformed booster-separation sensor
measures.measure_description: Inspect Soyuz rockets being prepared for upcoming flights to make sure no similar problems exist.
measures.notes: Reported by a news article; no changed assembly procedures were reported.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Sensor damaged during final assembly at Baikonur
measures.measure_description: Verify the booster-separation sensor after final assembly and before rollout.
measures.notes: Derived from the reported finding that the sensor was damaged during final assembly; how it was bent was not stated.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Flight control system faults and pyro firing errors
measures.measure_description: Carry out additional tests of the flight control system.
measures.notes: Read via a specialist website; the commission report itself was not read.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Hazardous pre-launch sequence on a fuelled rocket
measures.measure_description: Re-evaluate the sequence of pre-launch processing to improve safety measures.
measures.notes: Read via a specialist website; the commission report itself was not read.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Current distributor not in zero position before onboard power was activated
measures.measure_description: Reconfigure the current distributor to the zero position before onboard power is activated.
measures.recommendation_ref: Commission statement of how the fire could have been avoided
measures.notes: Read via a specialist website; the commission report itself was not read.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Design and production flaws in the control panel electrical circuit
measures.measure_description: Correct the design and production flaws in the control panel electrical circuit that caused wrong pyromembranes to fire.
measures.notes: Derived from the cause chain described on the page.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: About 150-250 people near a fuelled rocket; rules not enforced in front of senior officer
measures.measure_description: Keep non-essential personnel away from a fuelled vehicle and give range safety officers authority that does not depend on rank.
measures.recommendation_ref: Violated safety rules on source page
measures.notes: Page states non-essential personnel were meant to leave during fuelling and range officials could not enforce rules in front of Nedelin.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: No procedure to drain propellant from a fuelled vehicle; leak tolerated
measures.measure_description: Provide a procedure to drain propellant from a fuelled vehicle and do not tolerate propellant leaks or work on a fuelled rocket.
measures.recommendation_ref: Source page notes no drain procedure
measures.notes: Page records a leak of about 142-145 drops per minute accepted as tolerable.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Schedule pressure to launch by 7 November
measures.measure_description: Do not let calendar or political deadlines override stop-work and drain decisions.
measures.notes: Derived from the page account of schedule pressure.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Nitrogen COPV with undetected or under-screened damage
measures.measure_description: Lower the operating pressure of COPVs.
measures.notes: Reported by a news article; SpaceX primary statement not read.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: COPV damage during Starship assembly
measures.measure_description: Add protective covers to guard tanks during Starship assembly.
measures.notes: Reported by a news article; SpaceX primary statement not read.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Internal COPV damage not detected
measures.measure_description: Introduce new COPV inspection and testing procedures, including a non-destructive evaluation method to find internal damage.
measures.notes: Reported by a news article; SpaceX primary statement not read.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Root cause unknown at the time
measures.measure_description: Pause Ship static fires until the root cause is identified.
measures.notes: Interim measure reported shortly after the event.

measures.accident_name: Soyuz T-10-1 on-pad fire and launch escape
measures.failure_mode_addressed: Fuel valve or turbopump fault leading to a pad fire
measures.measure_description: Corrective action was taken after investigation; the source gives no detail.
measures.notes: Sources differ on the fault: one says a valve let nitrogen into the kerosene turbopump; another says a fuel valve feeding the strap-on boosters failed to close.

measures.accident_name: Soyuz T-10-1 on-pad fire and launch escape
measures.failure_mode_addressed: Fire burned through the ground command lines to the escape system; backup needed two simultaneous ground commands
measures.measure_description: Provide an escape-system trigger path that a pad fire cannot disable; the automatic path failed when the lines burned through and the backup required coordinated human action within about five seconds.
measures.notes: Derived from the documented abort sequence; the sources do not say whether the trigger path was later changed.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Crew response to a fire in the station
measures.measure_description: Change emergency training for crews.
measures.notes: Date in S47 is 23 Feb 1997 while Accidents lists 1997-02-24 (likely a time-zone difference).

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Ground response to the fire
measures.measure_description: Change ground controller response.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Contaminated oxygen-generator canister
measures.measure_description: Change how SFOG canisters are prepared on the ground.
measures.notes: Specific preparation changes were not stated.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Lessons for later stations
measures.measure_description: Carry lessons from the fire into ISS design and operations.
measures.notes: Qualitative statement only.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Latex glove material and hydrocarbons in the canister
measures.measure_description: Exclude latex and hydrocarbon contaminants from oxygen-candle canisters during preparation.
measures.notes: Derived from the finding that latex glove material was the most likely culprit and that hydrocarbons raised the risk.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Flames blocked access to a Soyuz escape craft
measures.measure_description: Keep access to the escape vehicle clear of fire-prone equipment, or provide an alternative route.
measures.notes: Derived from the documented gap that the flame blocked access to the Soyuz.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Re-entry instructions had to be printed from the station computer
measures.measure_description: Keep emergency return instructions available without relying on the station computer.
measures.notes: Derived from the documented gap.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Wiring and solder joint integrity in the inertial platform torque motor
measures.measure_description: Study the motor wiring to alleviate the impact of unavoidable deflection on solder joint integrity.
measures.notes: The IRC activity was not authorised by a US export licence (per the Cox Report); recorded here only for its technical content.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Manufacturing quality of the inertial measurement unit
measures.measure_description: Raise manufacturing quality standards.
measures.notes: The IRC activity was not authorised by a US export licence (per the Cox Report); recorded here only for its technical content.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Environmental testing
measures.measure_description: Re-examine environmental tests.
measures.notes: The IRC activity was not authorised by a US export licence (per the Cox Report); recorded here only for its technical content.

measures.failure_mode_addressed: Failure mode not fully explained by the PRC analysis
measures.measure_description: Explain the total flight behaviour to fully confirm the failure mode.
measures.notes: The IRC activity was not authorised by a US export licence (per the Cox Report); recorded here only for its technical content.

accidents.name: Apollo 1 (Apollo 204) cabin fire
accidents.failure_category: Electrical arc ignition of combustibles in oxygen-rich cabin
accidents.root_cause: Pure-oxygen atmosphere at above-ambient pressure with many combustible materials near possible ignition sources; the Board called the test conditions 'extremely hazardous'.

accidents.name: Apollo 13 service module oxygen tank explosion
accidents.failure_category: Cryogenic oxygen tank combustion/explosion from electrical fault
accidents.root_cause: Review Board (Cortright): 'an unusual combination of mistakes coupled with a somewhat deficient and unforgiving design.'

accidents.name: Space Shuttle Challenger (STS-51-L)
accidents.failure_category: Solid rocket booster joint seal failure leading to structural breakup
accidents.root_cause: Design flaw in the O-ring field joint (Commission: 'an accident rooted in history').

accidents.name: Space Shuttle Columbia (STS-107)
accidents.failure_category: Thermal protection damage leading to re-entry heat intrusion
accidents.root_cause: Foam loss from the bipod ramp (several factors combined; subsurface defects found in dissected ramps) striking an RCC system designed with almost no impact resistance.

accidents.name: Antares Orb-3 launch failure
accidents.failure_category: Engine turbopump explosion and liquid-oxygen fire
accidents.root_cause: Three credible technical root causes (any one or a combination): inadequate design robustness of the AJ26 LO2 HBA and turbine-end bearing; foreign object debris (titanium and silica) in E15 (no clear link established); manufacturing/workmanship defect in the E15 turbine bearing bore housing.

accidents.name: SpaceX CRS-7 Falcon 9 in-flight failure
accidents.failure_category: Pressure vessel (helium COPV) support-strut failure leading to second-stage overpressure
accidents.root_cause: Preliminary (per SpaceX): strut failure with material weakness; strut designed for 10,000 lbf versus an estimated 2,000 lbf load. Musk called it 'a really odd failure mode' and 'somewhat speculative'.

accidents.name: SpaceX Falcon 9 AMOS-6 pad explosion
accidents.failure_category: Composite overwrapped pressure vessel (COPV) failure with liquid-oxygen ignition
accidents.root_cause: Likely mechanism: oxygen trapped between COPV liner and overwrap ignited, as above.

accidents.name: Ariane 5 Flight 501 maiden-flight failure
accidents.failure_category: Software specification/design error in inertial reference system leading to loss of control
accidents.root_cause: Specification and design errors in the inertial reference system software.

accidents.name: Nedelin catastrophe (R-16 pad explosion)
accidents.failure_category: Hypergolic propellant ignition on the pad during servicing
accidents.root_cause: Per the NASA summary: personnel and visitors near the pad exceeded safe limits while technicians were repairing a fully fuelled rocket.

accidents.name: Starship Ship 36 test-stand explosion
accidents.failure_category: Suspected nitrogen COPV failure during propellant loading
accidents.root_cause: Preliminary only (full data review was ongoing at the time of the article).

accidents.name: Soyuz T-10-1 on-pad fire and launch escape
accidents.failure_category: Kerosene leak from turbopump failure causing a pad fire
accidents.root_cause: Faulty valve admitting nitrogen into the fuel turbopump.

accidents.name: Mir space station fire (Kvant-1)
accidents.failure_category: Solid-fuel oxygen generator (SFOG / Vika) canister fire
accidents.root_cause: After two years of study, investigators named latex glove material accidentally introduced into the canister as the most likely culprit; hydrocarbons in the canister raised the risk.

accidents.name: Intelsat 708 / Long March 3B launch failure
accidents.failure_category: Guidance/control hardware failure leading to crash and explosion
accidents.root_cause: Per the revised PRC finding: deteriorated gold-aluminum wiring connections in the power amplifier of the follow-up frame torque motor.
